body:
Residual of #867 (`fix/867-nitrogen`); red-team r1 confirmed R1-R5, and R6 was found while drafting.

Tier: **B/DECISION**.
- Measured by r1 on the branch and on base, so it predates #867:
  - Ethiopia `on='parcel'` gives 0 rows plus `PlotGrainMismatchWarning`; `on='plot'` gives 21,786 rows.
  - Malawi `on='parcel'` gives 11,622 plots at median **0.10** kg N/ha; `on='plot'` gives 33,402 at median 26.25.
- The 2016-17 / 2019-20 garden-plot keys (`RG01_R01`) are cut to the garden (`RG01`) on the `plot_features` side only, by `_parcel_from_feature_plot` (`transformations.py:4786`).
- The docstring at `transformations.py:6708-6711` ("Measured no-op on Malawi … 99.9%") is false today.
- Fix: make the parcel reduction symmetric, or choose `on` per country. Then correct the docstring.
title: `fertilizer_rate`'s default `on='parcel'` mis-joins Malawi and empties Ethiopia; its docstring's "measured no-op on Malawi" is false
